comment: AGOS Executive Memory: WHY the company changed direction, distinct from the operational Decision Memory (ledger). Five years from now, 'why did we do this' is answered here, not from anyone's recollection.

entries.decision: Found AEGIBIT as a zero-spend, cybersecurity-first, honesty-absolute company.
entries.reason: Premium global standard without burn; trust as the moat; founder covenant with Aira as AI co-founder.
entries.outcome: Registered (MSME, trade license, TM filed, GST). Products live. First repeat clients.

entries.decision: Build one Autonomous Growth Operating System instead of six separate automation engines.
entries.reason: Isolated scripts do not compound; a shared knowledge graph plus a decision gate does.
entries.outcome: AGOS Phases A-C shipped in 72 hours. Pending: first measured outcomes.

entries.decision: Prioritize GEO (AI citability) over competitor monitoring.
entries.reason: Zero-cost, compounding asset, fits authority strategy; monitoring is spend without an asset.

entries.decision: Freeze AGOS Core v1.0 (ADR-001). All future effort goes to Knowledge, Evidence, or Revenue.
entries.reason: Architecture is sufficient to build a company on; advantage now compounds through execution, not design.
entries.outcome: Design era closed. Execution era open.

entries.decision: Adopt the Weekly Executive Review (10 questions, one page, every Monday) and the five CEO metrics as the company's steering instruments.
entries.reason: Alignment with reality beats dashboards; five trending metrics cover what matters.

entries.decision: First founder-approved experiment: glossary initiative (exp-glossary-geo), Founder Twin observation #1.
entries.reason: Correctly framed comparative hypothesis with measurable outcomes; evidence will decide expansion or rollback.

entries.decision: Concentrate GEO authority on the AI-agent / MCP security wedge first (per GEO Authority Roadmap v1.0), then expand outward on the authority it generates.
entries.reason: Evidence: named Kolkata competitors own directories/reviews/age we lack, but NONE own AI-agent/MCP security, a new, uncrowded category where AEGIBIT holds a real differentiated product (MCP Shield) and first-mover content. Fastest honest path to being an AI-cited answer.
entries.outcome: Ratified by founder 2026-08-04. Cornerstone pillar /ai-agent-security in build. Founder-gated trust signals (reviews, MCP Shield public, directories) still pending founder action.
